info.title: fiscalm API
info.description: Seller-save, the series operations (create, continue, default, remove) and logo operations are app/CLI configuration, not exposed by API v1. See docs/api.md.

all_firms.description: Accept documents for every configured firm; unclear buyers wait for assignment.

schema.description: Flat string/integer fields, no booleans. co, if supplied, must match the URL. See x-action-fields for each action. Integration changes require app authentication and return app_required for bearer requests.

x-action-fields.settlement-withdraw: id Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.settlement-confirm: id: 32-hex report ID; tx: 20-hex exact displayed credit ID; confirmed: yes. Local operation; v1 requires a write key owned by an active person (else 403 person_owned_key_required). Rechecks all evidence under lock. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.emag-refund: id: company-scoped order sheet ID; prepares a refund draft, never sends money. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.emag-resolve: id: company-scoped order sheet ID; acknowledges the current review. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.mark-paid: id; method: how the person paid, one of bank (the firm's account), card (a firm card), cash, own (their own money) or other; detail: card: one of firm_cards (required once the firm has one), own: who paid, other: a short note, both required, at most 200 characters; empty for bank and cash. Records a fact only: the invoice stays marked, awaiting a statement or a mail, whatever the method. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.reopen: id Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.withdraw: id, method, detail: as mark-paid. Takes the invoice out of the payment file and marks it paid. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.pack-prepare: month: YYYY-MM. Freeze the company ZIP for download; an unsent stale version is replaced by a new one, a sent one never. Local in both modes. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.pack-sent: month, version: exact prepared ZIP SHA-256; optional mark: the report's mark as shown, refused once the pack was sent or unsent since. Human confirms sending only that snapshot. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.check: No fields. Starts the tick; permitted in shadow mode, which the tick respects. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.mail-answer: In v1 who must equal the URL company or none (else wrong_company). key (a to_check[].key this co is offered for), who (one of its companies, or none: not an invoice), optional total (the index into its totals as a digit string, needed when it has several), optional remember (1: the exact sender address goes the same way next time) Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.issued-mark: id, method (bank: payment order, cash, card, other), detail: for other, how it was collected (1 to 200 characters); else empty. Never proof: the invoice awaits a statement credit. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.issued-unmark: id Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.resolve-debit: tx, target (one of its candidates[].id) Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.credit-pick: id: a received credit note with credit_question; target: one of its credit_question[].id, or "-" when it cancels none of them. The first answer stands; local operation. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.upload-link-create: label; optional all_firms (boolean), expires_in_days (1..365), max_files (positive integer). Write scope required; explicit upload-link routes are also available. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.upload-link-revoke: id: upload link ID. Write scope required; explicit upload-link routes are also available. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.integration-add: App authentication required; bearer requests return 403 app_required. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.integration-update: App authentication required; bearer requests return 403 app_required. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.integration-clear: App authentication required; bearer requests return 403 app_required. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.integration-enable: App authentication required; bearer requests return 403 app_required. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.integration-default: App authentication required; bearer requests return 403 app_required. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.
x-action-fields.integration-remove: App authentication required; bearer requests return 403 app_required. Effect: local; allowed in shadow.

role.description: What the firm saves the partner as, added to its roles; a new one is a client unless given. Without id, a firm already saved keeps its details and only gains the role.

post.description: Echo the draft version read from the workspace. Existing-draft saves require it; issue always requires it. Stale versions return stale_draft (409).

iban.description: The firm's current account the invoice asks to be paid into; without it, the seller profile's. Checked again at issue.

product_id.description: Optional product of this invoice's firm. Copy catalog defaults when choosing a product, then send the line's own values. Saved lines never follow later catalog edits. New links require an active product; an archived product already on any line of this draft or its existing recurring template may stay. Recurrence context comes only from the rule runner, never from request fields. Only copy price when currencies match; no conversion is inferred.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Per token and company for 24 hours. Same operation and JSON body replays the exact committed result; changed operation/body returns 409. Retry a 500 with the same key/body. Refusals are not cached. Issue/storno and replay commit atomically; issuing never uploads to SPV (see spv.upload_on). Other routes reject this header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Per token and company for 24 hours. Same operation and JSON body replays the exact committed result; changed operation/body returns 409. Retry a 500 with the same key/body. Refusals are not cached. Issue/storno and replay commit atomically; issuing never uploads to SPV (see spv.upload_on). Other routes reject this header.

403.description: App admin required; bearer tokens cannot change automation rules.

post.description: App-admin configuration only. Bearer requests always return 403 admin_required.
Atomic shop order intake; live-only lifecycle webhooks use HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + dot + raw JSON), X-Fiscalm-Signature, durable retries and stable event IDs. See x-shop-webhooks in this schema.

x-shop-webhooks.description: Live-only, at-least-once delivery to operator-configured webhook_url with webhook_secret. Never accept a destination from an order; redirects refuse. Verify the signature against the raw body and check freshness before deduplicating by event ID. Non-2xx/transport errors retry with exponential backoff capped at one hour; crashes can redeliver the same event. Only statement-confirmed collection emits invoice.collected, never shop payment metadata.

headers.X-Fiscalm-Timestamp: ASCII Unix seconds used in the signature; reject stale timestamps.
headers.X-Fiscalm-Event-Id: Stable event ID, identical to payload id. Deduplicate after signature verification.
headers.X-Fiscalm-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(webhook_secret, ASCII timestamp + '.' + raw UTF-8 body)>

payload.order_id: Order ID; may be null on intake refusal
payload.invoice_id: Invoice ID; may be null on intake refusal
payload.reason: Optional safe refusal code, never raw SPV, buyer, bank or exception data

x-browser-auth.origin: Pinned FISCALM_PUBLIC_URL HTTPS origin; Host is checked even for public routes, except /healthz. Forwarded headers are ignored unless the backend is private to an explicitly trusted proxy.

me.response: me (id, username, display_name, role, can), auth (via, method, recovery_only), factors (password_totp, passkeys_available, passkeys). Passkey metadata: id (base64url), name, backup_eligible, backed_up, created_at, last_used_at; no public-key material or secrets. A missing/expired/insecure cookie returns 401 with methods.password=true and methods.passkey indicating DNS-origin support.

bootstrap.query: co: selected firm key or ALL (default). Unknown firms select ALL.
bootstrap.response: identity: the /me shape; state: state-summary including Acasă first dashboard pages (null for recovery-only sessions); live: boolean. Identity, authorization and state share one database snapshot of the request cookie. Match identity user, role, auth and current session digest against the displayed identity before applying state; discard replies across session-change generations. No raw session id is returned.

x-browser-auth.transport: POST requires a matching Origin, application/json, at most 4096 bytes, no ambiguous framing, and same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site when supplied. No CORS. One shared 20-per-minute IP budget across authentication flows, persistent account lockout and 5-try single-use factor tickets.
x-browser-auth.responses: Password returns only a ticket, never a session. TOTP or verified passkey sign-in sets the HttpOnly cookie. Setup begin returns ticket, secret and otpauth URI; setup finish returns 10 recovery codes and sets the cookie. link means only the setup URL fragment. Recovery-only sessions can read me, replace the factor permitted by their proof, or sign out. Finishing passkey recovery clears every session and the cookie; finishing TOTP recovery closes every other session and sets a normal cookie, since the password, a recovery code and the new TOTP were all proved. auth.method is password_totp, passkey, recovery (password plus recovery code), or recovery_code (code-only passkey recovery). signout takes {} and clears the cookie. No raw session id is in JSON.

passkeys.origin: Requires a DNS host in the pinned HTTPS origin; HTTPS IP installs refuse passkey operations with 400. Changing the RP host requires re-enrolment or CLI/admin reset.
passkeys.options: Options endpoints return {ok,ticket,publicKey}. publicKey is WebAuthn JSON options with unpadded base64url binary values, UV required, and discoverable credentials. Registration requests residentKey required, attestation none and ES256/EdDSA/RS256. No account name is submitted for passkey sign-in; step-up is fixed to the current cookie's account.
passkeys.proof: All binary proof fields are canonical unpadded base64url strings. transports is a JSON-array string of browser hints, never identity proof. Challenge/type/origin/RP/UP/UV, exact credential owner and userHandle, signature and counter are checked. A positive counter must increase, including refusal of a return to zero. One-use tickets are five minutes and five attempts. Failed proof commits its attempt; final publication errors roll back factor/counter, ticket and session together.
passkeys.registration: setup/passkey uses a current one-time factorless-account setup link. me/passkey add/rename/remove requires a normal recent own session of any role under the write lock. No body user id is accepted. Last-factor removal refuses. Adding a key closes other own sessions; setup/sign-in/step-up rotate the presented cookie atomically.
passkeys.recovery: recover/code {username,code} is the one entry, refused with an existing browser session. Every refusal is the same 401, so nothing tells whether the account exists or which factor it uses before one 80-bit code is spent. For an account with a complete password/TOTP method it returns only {ok,ticket}; recover/password {username,ticket,password} then proves the password (a forged or spent ticket counts as a wrong password) and issues recovery/recovery_only access confined to TOTP replacement. For a passkey-only account it issues recovery_code/recovery_only access at once; recover/passkey options/finish accept only that exact proof/session/user, replace all old keys and password/TOTP, rotate codes, close every session/ticket/link and clear the cookie, so fresh key sign-in is required. Recovery provenance cannot cross flows.

x-browser-auth.own_account: GET /web/api/me includes active sessions (one-way id digest, current flag, method, created_at, last_seen_at, device (for example Chrome pe Linux, named by the engine from the user agent), ip) and recovery_codes_remaining. POST /auth/me/recovery-codes regenerates ten codes once, voiding the old set; /auth/me/session-close accepts only an own session id, clearing the cookie when current; /auth/me/sessions-close-others keeps the current session. Password replacement POST /auth/me/password-change {password} hashes outside the write lock, rechecks the proved credentials and closes other sessions and pending tickets; TOTP replacement POST /auth/me/totp/begin {} returns a pending secret/URI/ticket, and /auth/me/totp/finish {ticket,code} activates only that session’s verified replacement and regenerates codes. The old factor works until commit; no password-only factor/removal path exists. All own-account mutations require a normal session of any role plus step-up within ten minutes, rechecked under the write lock. No supplied user id is accepted. Recovery-only sessions are refused.

sensitive_actions.description: A normal cookie session needs fresh authentication for user administration, session-close, token creation. Step-up takes the identity from the current cookie, never from a submitted username.

document_upload.body: multipart/form-data, 1 to 10 parts named files: JPEG, PNG, HEIC or PDF by their first bytes, 15 MiB each, 40 MiB per request. Budgeted like a Bondrop link per member (60 files and 50 MiB an hour, 250 MiB a day), within the company's shared upload budget.
document_upload.response: {ok, files: [{sha, duplicate}]} in request order. Each file is stored like a Bondrop upload, named by its sha256 inside the company's own inbox, and becomes a receipt to check. No file name is read. With tx (one file only), the file is the bon of that card debit of the company: it takes the debit's amount, day, month and card and explains it, through the same guarded link as tx-link (kind receipt); a debit already explained, a credit, or a bon another debit names or that has its own data is refused with 409 and a message, and the file stays stored. Allowed in Sandbox. Refusals: 400 framing or query, 401/403 session, role or Origin, 408 too slow, 409 storage, 413 too large or too many, 415 other types, 429 budget used, 503 busy, 507 disk full.

x-app-token-management.list: /web/api/tokens: normal accounts see only their own metadata; administrators see all, including revoked historical ownerless entries.
x-app-token-management.create: /web/api/token-create {name,scope}: fresh normal session; current user is owner. Administrator/member may choose read or write; readonly may choose read only. Returns done.id/token/scope once.
x-app-token-management.revoke: /web/api/token-revoke {id}: normal session, own token only; administrators may revoke any. Owner, enabled actor and live administrator status are checked inside the same write lock. No body owner/actor override is accepted.
x-app-token-management.capabilities: me.can.own_tokens permits the own-token surface; me.can.manage_tokens permits administrator visibility/revocation; me.can.write limits the offered scopes. Bearer credentials never manage credentials.

get./web/api/auth-events: Latest 100 events, newest first: at, kind, user_id, actor, detail. No secrets.

x-app-user-administration.description: Normal administrator cookie required. Every mutation also requires step-up within 10 minutes, rechecked under the same write lock. Unknown fields and actor/owner overrides are refused. user-create and setup/reset return done.url only once: a relative /setup#id.secret link valid 72 hours. Session id is a stored digest, never the raw cookie. Disabled users lose browser access and tokens immediately. Cannot remove the last working administrator. No company access restrictions.

x-app-integrations.description: ANAF/mail items carry firm_scope. All includes future firms; explicit keys must exist; [] serves none. Disabled instances do not cover firms.

post.mail-microsoft-start: address, optional id, optional firm_scope. New inbox scope defaults to all and is stored before authorization. Scope is refused for existing inbox reconnects, including reuse by address.
post.integration-add: kind, name, f_<field>, optional firm_scope (default all). Success: done {id: created instance id}
post.integration-update: id, optional name, f_<field>, optional firm_scope (omitted preserves scope)

coverage.description: One row per firm in company order. anaf is last successful reader if still enabled and covering, else oldest. anaf_also contains other enabled covering connections.

x-app-ai-cli.description: App administrator only. Origin required on POST; JSON up to 4096 bytes. Official CLI-owned login, status and logout. No credentials or raw output are exposed; configuration is allowed in shadow.

post.code: Only for code: one authorization code, 1..2048 characters, sent to CLI stdin, never persisted or logged.

response.provider: CLI provider, or empty before login
response.url: Only HTTPS on the selected provider's allowlisted domains; no userinfo, fragment or token query parameters
response.code: Only the short public device code, otherwise empty
response.needs_code: Whether CLI asks for a pasted authorization code
response.install_command: Native install or Docker rebuild command; absent on POST

x-app-product-stats.query: co: one firm (ALL refused); month: YYYY-MM, default current server month; months: 1 or 12, default 1. The selected month ends the range.
x-app-product-stats.response: ProductSales. Revenue excludes VAT and includes signed storno lines; quantity is decimal text; invoice_count counts distinct documents including storno. Groups are separate per product, currency and unit. Current catalog names include archived products. Lines without a product, including external SPV invoices, use product_id=null and name=Fără produs. Unavailable or truncated external UBL contributes no guessed amount and makes its month and the range incomplete, with unavailable_count. Unparsed SPV messages use their listing month because their issue date is unknown. Authored invoices and their SPV copies are counted once, including unlinked copies with the same firm, number, date and kind. Includes local Sandbox invoices; production-rejected invoices are excluded, matching turnover. Imports kept only in history are outside this report's coverage. All months use two batched queries; each external file is read once.

x-app-products.query: co: one firm key (required); id: optional product id for detail. ALL refused. List: q searches name/code; f empty=active or archived; cursor is a nonnegative offset, limit 1..200 (default 50).
x-app-products.response: Products, or ProductDetail with id; list defaults to active entries, with total and next_cursor. Archived entries use f=archived. InvoicingWorkspace.products contains all active entries for the local picker. Unknown detail returns 404.
x-app-products.writes: POST /web/api/product-add|product-update|product-archive|product-delete with {co, ...fields}. Member role, local in Sandbox. Bodies in x-app-products.bodies; result.done.product contains the saved Product (delete: id only). Refresh catalog after writes.

x-app-actions.product-update: Company catalog defaults; local in Sandbox. Version guards edits; delete refuses any invoice reference.

x-app-actions.user-create: Account administration; fresh administrator session required. username display_name role.
x-app-actions.user-update: Account administration; fresh administrator session required. id display_name role.
x-app-actions.user-disable: Account administration; fresh administrator session required. id.
x-app-actions.user-enable: Account administration; fresh administrator session required. id.

x-app-actions.session-close: Account administration; fresh administrator session required. id.
x-app-actions.history-review: Review one pending history PDF by digest, correcting invoice fields or excluding it. Local only; never confirms payment.
x-app-actions.setup-card-dismiss: Close the selected firm's Configurează card on Acasă; the items it listed stay in Setări, and `setup-card-show` reopens it. Administrator only; repeating it changes nothing.
x-app-actions.setup-card-show: Show the selected firm's closed Configurează card on Acasă again, while something is left to set up. Administrator only; repeating it changes nothing.
x-app-actions.telemetry-settings: on ("1" or "0"). Administrator only. Daily anonymous Live install statistics, enabled by default; FISCALM_TELEMETRY=0 overrides this local preference.
x-app-actions.update-checks: on ("1" or "0"). App administrator only. Enable or disable the anonymous daily GitHub Releases check, also allowed in shadow mode.
x-app-actions.accountant-save: cui (existing partner), senders (newline-separated addresses, at most ten), recipient, co. App admin configuration.
x-app-actions.settlement-withdraw: Withdraw pending settlement evidence; never release a reserved credit.
x-app-actions.settlement-format-delete: partner, signature: one of the partner's report_formats. Forgets the saved columns; uploaded reports are unchanged.
x-app-actions.settlement-format-senders: partner, signature: one of the partner's report_formats; senders: newline-separated exact addresses (at most ten, empty to stop). Mailed CSV/XLSX reports in that format from those addresses are imported, read-only.
x-app-actions.order-discard: co, id: company-scoped order sheet ID. App-only local configuration.
x-app-actions.pack-unsent: month, version: the sent ZIP SHA-256; mark: the report's mark as shown. Undoes pack-sent: the snapshot is prepared again and the documents only it covers are unsent. Local operation.
x-app-actions.document-correct: Correct receipt/document metadata only. amount: exact two-decimal string; currency: engine currency code; date and number optional. Refuses settled proof and sent accountant packs; records actor, time and previous values. Never settles money.
x-app-actions.upload-assign: Assign an unassigned upload to a configured firm. First answer wins.
x-app-actions.rule-supplier-autopay: cui (a partner's, from the state), on (1/0)
x-app-actions.rule-partner-not-mailed: partner (a partner's id, from the state), on (1/0)
x-app-actions.rule-spv-delay: days (digit string, 0..5): days after issue the tick sends an invoice to SPV; refused while spv_auto_upload is off
x-app-actions.card-owner: tx (an observed card transaction), owner (a companies[].key or personal); first answer wins, never confirms payment
x-app-actions.tx-link: kind (documents, the default; label: Fără document, reason one of bank_fee, interest, personal, other and an optional note for the accountant, required for other, at most 200 characters; transfer: Transfer între conturi; advance: Avans, who the administrator or associate, 1 to 100 characters), tx (a transactions.rows[].id; for an explanation already made, its link.tx), invoices (comma-separated ids: issued[].id for a credit, invoices[].id for a debit) or payment (one payments.*[].item_id, debits only), reason ("" or one of rest, courier_fee, bank_fee, fx, other), note (other only, 1 to 200 characters), was (the row's explanation.link.id, "" for none), remember ("", or one of the row's remember keys: iban, card for a label only, name; never for a transfer)
x-app-actions.tx-receipt: tx (a card debit in transactions.rows[].id, not explained), id (documents[].id of an upload of this firm whose amount is still null): the upload is this debit's bon and takes its amount, day and card. Local bookkeeping; refused when the debit or the upload is already explained or the upload has data of its own.
x-app-actions.tx-await: tx (a debit in transactions.rows[].id, not explained or settled), on ("1" waits, "0" stops waiting), note (on=1 only, optional, what is expected, at most 200 characters). Aștept factura: the debit stays to explain, listed last, and reserves nothing. Local operation.
x-app-actions.token-create: name, scope (read/write). Fresh normal session; owner is the current user; read-only accounts can create read tokens only. Returns secret once.
x-app-actions.token-revoke: id. Normal session; revokes own credential, administrator may revoke any.
x-app-actions.mail-microsoft-start: Start read-only Microsoft device flow. address required, id optional for reconnect. Optional firm_scope (all or firm-key array) is stored before a new inbox can connect; default all. A supplied scope is refused when reconnecting an existing inbox, including address-based reuse. done: code=authorization_pending, id, user_code, verification_uri, expires_in seconds, interval seconds. Persist id for poll. No device code or tokens returned. Errors: not_configured, invalid_settings, admin_consent_required, tenant_policy_blocked, connection_failed.
x-app-actions.mail-microsoft-poll: Poll Microsoft device flow by integration id from start, same user. done.code: authorization_pending or slow_down (wait done.interval seconds), connected (done.id), expired_token, authorization_declined, admin_consent_required, tenant_policy_blocked, account_mismatch, connection_changed, reconnect_required, invalid_scopes, connection_failed. Stop on terminal errors. integration.config.method=microsoft; reading.code=reconnect_required means Reconectează.
x-app-actions.mail-detect: address: email. done: method (microsoft offers device button, imap offers password), provider, host, port (993), username, app_password_required, app_password_url, hint, supported, hosts (ordered fallback candidates). Invalid address: done.code=invalid_settings. MX discovery is bounded; no credentials.
x-app-actions.mail-test: Either id alone (saved mail account) or from_address, password and optional host, port (993 only), username, read_folder (INBOX). Never saves. done.code: ok, wrong_password, app_password_required, host_unreachable, tls_error, folder_missing, timeout, invalid_settings, unsupported_provider, protocol_error. Success also returns host, port, username for integration-add f_<field>. Verified TLS, LOGIN, EXAMINE, LOGOUT only; public IPs only. No password or raw server reply returned.
x-app-actions.integration-add: kind, name, f_<field> per field; optional firm_scope all or firm-key array (ANAF/mail); success done contains only id of the created instance
x-app-actions.company-lookup: { "cui": "12345674" }. Refused with done.retry=true when ANAF gave no usable answer (ask again later), without it when ANAF does not know the CUI.
x-app-actions.company-add: { "cui": "12345674", "name": "Exemplu", "palette": "blue" } (name, palette optional). Looks the CUI up again; refused with done.retry=true when ANAF gave no usable answer.
x-app-actions.company-statement-password: { "key": "EXEMPLU", "bank": "bt", "password": "<parola>" } (all required; bank: a catalogue bank with password-protected PDF statements). Write-only: never returned or logged.
x-app-actions.statement-csv-format: account, co; column names from fiscalm.bank.csv.FIELDS plus date_format and decimal, all strings. App admin configuration.
x-app-actions.bank-setup: operation: prepare (generate key once, return public certificate and configured callback URLs; no network) or check (verify Enable Banking application). No private key or session is returned. Read-only banking allowed in shadow mode.
x-app-actions.bank-connect: bank (catalogue ID), co; no other fields. App admin; starts read-only account consent.
x-app-actions.bank-disconnect: bank (catalogue ID), co; no other fields. Stops future local bank reads and cancels pending consent choices. Keeps all history and statement imports; no provider call or remote revocation.
x-app-actions.bank-accounts: operation=list returns only the creator’s unexpired masked account offers. operation=confirm, offer (opaque ID), accounts (opaque IDs) registers and connects exactly the selected accounts atomically. No IBAN, URL, session or provider UID is accepted.

bearerAuth.description: User-owned, scoped install-wide fiscalm token. Rights are scope intersected with the owner’s current role; a disabled owner returns 401, read-only writes return 403 insufficient_scope. All routes require the configured Host and port.

status.description: open; linked to a payment file; marked by a user awaiting proof; paid with confirmation; or skipped.

payment_state.description: For a linked invoice: held, in_file, lost or imported; otherwise null.

bon.description: Linked receipt document ID, or null. Never infer a link from matching amounts alone.

paid_detail.description: card: the card's last four digits; own: who paid; other: the person's note; else null.

paid_method.description: How the person who marked it said they paid (bank, card, cash, own, other), or null. Never proof.

total.description: Exact decimal amount with two places; never binary floating point. Currency is a separate field.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount with two places; never binary floating point. Currency is a separate field.

credits.description: Unambiguously linked received credit notes, scoped to this company, supplier and currency.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount with two places; never binary floating point. Currency is a separate field.

credit_question.description: For a credit note naming no invoice: the invoices it could cancel (same supplier and currency, exact opposite total, issued up to 14 days before), when several fit or SPV order or an archived invoice leaves one in doubt. None is cancelled until credit-pick.

credit_note.description: An unmatched received credit note; never payable.

covered.description: Amount covered by explicit transaction links.

left.description: Remaining payable amount after credit notes and explicit links; zero when closed.

proved.description: True only with payment evidence. A manual paid mark is not bank or mail proof.

status.description: A user's collected mark awaits proof; a statement-backed collection is distinct and cannot be unmarked.

note.description: For a user's mark collected another way (other): the person's note; else empty.

collected_method.description: For a user's mark: how they said the client paid (bank: payment order, cash, card, other), else null. Never proof.

total.description: Exact decimal amount with two places; never binary floating point. Currency is a separate field.

credited.description: Total of issued credit notes against this invoice.

covered.description: Amount covered by explicit transaction links.

owed.description: Outstanding amount after credit notes and explicit coverage.

left.description: Remaining amount to collect; zero once closed.

charts.description: Twelve months, oldest first. Native RON in total; other currencies separately, no conversion. Cash totals are null unless every configured current account has full trustworthy statement coverage. Observed includes deduplicated bank-feed lines and partial statements. No balance interpolation. Invoice series net credit notes on their own issue dates, including imported history. Collections/payments use bank booking dates and proof amounts; non-bank payment proofs use the recorded proof date. Aging covers tracked invoice rows only: payment orders such as taxes remain in payable but are outside invoice aging. Aging excludes unproved marks from debt buckets and keeps them in confirming. VAT is an invoice-tax estimate, not a declaration or deduction-eligibility decision. Missing tax evidence sets partial and missing_count; history without tax evidence is missing. Skipped purchases are excluded. Never infer tax from gross totals or convert currencies. Product sales reuse ProductSales through today, one result per firm even in ALL; period summaries group only like product ids, currencies and units. Product stats cover authored and external SPV detail, excluding history-only imports. External line nets with fractional cents are unavailable, keeping period and full-range cent totals consistent.

MCP.description: JSON-RPC 2.0, no batches, notifications return 202 without execution. Use tools/list for scope-filtered input schemas, tools/call for execution, ping for health. No resource or prompt capability is advertised. Legacy 2025-11-25 uses initialize; subsequent HTTP requests require MCP-Protocol-Version. Modern 2026-07-28 uses server/discover and params._meta io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion plus clientCapabilities; HTTP requires matching MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name for tools/call. HTTP Accept includes application/json and text/event-stream. Tools return JSON text and structuredContent on success, isError on refusal. Invoice issue/storno tools accept idempotency_key with the same semantics as the HTTP header.

BrowsePage.description: One current app list page. Sales, purchases and partners are newest first with stable source-order ties. Filters run on complete entities; total counts all matches regardless of cursor, months covers the complete category before filters. Sales and partners return existing state rows; purchases/receipts return id, company, invoice and document. Sales and purchases also list the firm's history invoices (kind history), never open or late. Sales alone accept f=storno (can_storno); partners alone accept f=accountant (a 2–10 digit CUI). Report sections require month (YYYY-MM), preserve section/source order and carry id/company/kind/data; they refuse f/q and include full ambiguous-candidate counts before nested bounding. A purchase scopes its invoice/receipt independently to the month's existing report references. Transactions return transaction plus said (text/optional target/proposal), derived from complete identities. They accept f=empty (unexplained), all, in or out; from/to are inclusive ISO dates and apply only to transactions. Their search includes bank text, raw/comma/grouped amounts and the same displayed explanation/proposal. Nested record lists are capped at 50; financial totals and currency aggregates stay complete. Cursor contains only date and ordinal, never payment keys; replace pages after writes/filter changes.

TransactionChoices.description: Current transaction-form choices, without linking or settling anything. Without collection, one full owner projection returns initial partners, invoices, payments, selected and receipts pages; with collection, just that page. Each has an exact matching total and offset cursor (default 50, maximum 200). Only partners of the transaction's direction are offered, including a credit holder's complete exposure. Invoices retain the existing open/marked, SPV-ready, non-rejected, positive-left and account/original-currency filters; amounts restore this link's own contribution before editing. Closed items selected by the current link remain available. selected pages all existing invoice choices independently of the primary row's nested-list cap; position preserves invoice order across pages/search. Invoices sort by date then case-folded number; partners by case-folded display name. Prepared payments retain held/in-file/lost/imported order, for debits with RON account or original currency only. Payment page IDs are keyed opaque identifiers; raw item_id is private and never appears in a cursor. receipts lists, for a debit only, the firm's uploaded files with no amount yet (held, unsent, without an invoice), in the documents order: the bon a person may name for it with tx-receipt. q is an accent-insensitive display-text substring (maximum 200 characters); it excludes private payment keys. partner applies only to invoices or the initial bundle; selected always uses the current link's partner. Only the initial bundle has proposed: at most the one open invoice of either partner whose number the bank details name, when the transaction equals its remaining amount in its currency (never for an explained transaction); else the open invoices of an AI proposal whose remaining amounts add up to the transaction in one currency. Its partner is the default partner before the one the bank text points to. A proposal is never applied: the user confirms it. Reads are current, not a cross-request snapshot; replace choices after writes.

StateDetail.description: One document, settlement, transaction or eMAG-task sheet, including an issued invoice's local-id alias. Money, identities and capabilities come from the complete company projection. related pages received credit notes, issued reversals or settlement lines in their existing order (default 50, maximum 200); its cursor continues through this same endpoint. The selected invoice contains the current related page. Receipt articles remain complete (at most 40). Other nested historical lists are capped at 50. Reads are current, not a cross-request snapshot. Order id uses the existing company:task_id sheet link; issued context identifies an already issued draft. The app also accepts ALL, reading only candidate owners of global IDs (or the first offered mail company), without retaining other firms' histories. Settlement totals/counts and confirmation capabilities precede paging. For transaction sheets only, transaction contains the complete said descriptor and exact link part/payment counts; related pages covered invoices then prepared payments in source order. Invoice numbers, remaining amounts and currencies have the existing missing-reference fallbacks. The shell keeps the selected transaction, its transfer counterpart, selected partner identities and settlement fee context; no unbounded form-choice arrays are included. The primary transaction's nested lists are capped at 50; use related and its exact total for covered rows. Invoice and issued sheets also carry lines: an invoice written here lists its stored lines, one read from SPV the lines of its stored XML (at most 200, truncated says more exist; descriptions at most 300 characters). unavailable means no stored document could be read, or one was refused or malformed; every line is checked, also those past the 200 returned, so it is never partial. Lines are display only: the totals above remain the invoice's amounts. A line's vat and gross are its net times vat_rate, rounded half up to the cent (null without a rate), so they can differ from the document's VAT by rounding. totals are the document's own: the totals an invoice written here was issued with (payable is its total), or the stored XML's LegalMonetaryTotal and its TaxTotal in the document currency, one tax per subtotal; null when they are missing or not decimal numbers, never summed from the lines. A null unit_price means a valid price per a positive base quantity other than one; a missing price or a malformed base quantity makes the document unavailable. Editable transactions also bundle five initial transaction-choices pages from the same owner projection; immutable transactions carry an empty choices object. Continue/filter through transaction-choices.

StateListPage.description: Existing state rows, at most 200, ordered by id (upcoming by date:side:who:opaque_id; candidates by engine date/number order). total counts all rows matching filters regardless of the cursor. id retrieves one row independently of the cursor and filters, including an issued invoice's local_id; upcoming uses cursor_id. candidates requires tx from the same company and uses opaque cursor_id; id accepts public payment IDs. Partner identities are computed on complete company data before paging. Reads are current, not snapshot-isolated across requests; replace pages after writes. This bounds transport, not the work needed to project a single company.

product_id.description: Optional product of this invoice's firm. Copy catalog defaults when choosing a product, then send the line's own values. Saved lines never follow later catalog edits. New links require an active product; an archived product already on any line of this draft or its existing recurring template may stay. Recurrence context comes only from the rule runner, never from request fields. Only copy price when currencies match; no conversion is inferred.
